scenes.text: This tutorial covers Invasion assay. Use two-color outside-versus-inside staining to distinguish attached from invaded parasites.
Open Invasion assay from the Toxoplasma assays section. Provide parasite and host-cell masks, inside and outside stain channels, plate metadata, and controls.
In the main configuration area, configure intensity thresholds, object matching, ambiguity handling, and well-level grouping.
Before the full run, review the visible settings and use a preview or test mode when one is available. review attached, invaded, and uncertain examples before accepting the classification rule.
When the workflow finishes, spaCR reports counts and invasion efficiency per well and condition with quality-control images.
